title: Battlepack section 39 — Shops

container.notes: Section 39 of battle_pack.bin (71-section battlepack, 16-byte aligned sections). NOT st2e: a bespoke three-level offset tree (shops -> events -> content ids). Every list has a 12-byte header: u16 tag=100, u16 level (0/1/2), u16 elementSize (8/8/2), u16 count, u32 listOffset; all offsets are relative to the start of section 39. Content lists are zero-padded to 4 bytes, the section to 16 bytes.

fields.name: tag
fields.notes: Constant 100 (0x64) at every level of the tree.

fields.name: level
fields.notes: Tree level: 0 (shop list).

fields.name: elementSize
fields.notes: Stride of the list this header introduces: 8.

fields.name: shopCount
fields.notes: Number of shops (57 in vanilla, TK L833).

fields.name: shopListOffset
fields.notes: Offset of shop[0] from the section start (12 in a rebuilt file: the list follows the header).

fields.name: ownerName
fields.notes: Text id of the shopkeeper/shop name.

fields.name: unused02
fields.notes: Unused attribute; the Workshop writes 0.

fields.name: eventTableOffset
fields.notes: Offset (from the section start) of this shop's eventTableHeader.

fields.name: tag
fields.notes: Constant 100 (0x64) at every level of the tree.

fields.name: level
fields.notes: Tree level: 1 (event list).

fields.name: elementSize
fields.notes: Stride of the list this header introduces: 8.

fields.name: eventCount
fields.notes: Number of stock events of this shop.

fields.name: eventListOffset
fields.notes: Offset of event[0]; 12 bytes after this header in a rebuilt file.

fields.name: condition
fields.notes: When this stock group becomes available.

fields.name: conditionOffsetParameter
fields.notes: Secondary parameter of the condition (Workshop: "condition offset parameter"; e.g. a byte/bit offset for custom conditions — unverified).

fields.name: conditionParameter
fields.notes: Main parameter of the condition (e.g. story progress value or clan rank).

fields.name: contentTableOffset
fields.notes: Offset (from the section start) of this event's contentTableHeader.

fields.name: tag
fields.notes: Constant 100 (0x64) at every level of the tree.

fields.name: level
fields.notes: Tree level: 2 (content list).

fields.name: elementSize
fields.notes: Stride of the list this header introduces: 2.

fields.name: contentCount
fields.notes: Number of content ids in this stock group.

fields.name: contentListOffset
fields.notes: Offset of content[0]; 12 bytes after this header in a rebuilt file.

records.name: content
records.where: section39 + contentTableHeader.contentListOffset + k*2; the list is zero-padded to a 4-byte boundary

fields.name: contentId
fields.notes: Content id offered for sale (category<<12 | index: items 0x0000, equipment 0x1000, magicks 0x3000, technicks 0x4000, gambits 0x6000 …).

roundTrip: For value-only edits (ownerName, event condition fields, swapping one content id for another) patch bytes in place; the file stays byte-identical elsewhere.
Never rebuild the section unless an event or content count changes; a rebuild may reorder blocks relative to vanilla.
When rebuilding: write the 12-byte headers with their fixed signatures, recompute every offset relative to the section start, pad each content list to 4 bytes and the section to 16 bytes with zeros.
Preserve shop.unused02 bytes from the original when rebuilding (the Workshop zeroes them).
If the section length changes, rewrite the battlepack offset table (all later sections and the end offset).
Keep shop order: shop index is the merchant id the game opens.
gaps: Exact meaning of conditionOffsetParameter and conditionParameter for each condition type (custom / story progress / clan rank).
Whether vanilla blocks are laid out in the same order as the Workshop writes them (a rebuild may not be byte-identical even without edits).
Content of shop.unused02 in vanilla data (the Workshop discards it).
Which text block shop.ownerName ids belong to (assumed the character-name block, 16384+).
Whether events are cumulative (all satisfied events add stock) or exclusive — assumed cumulative.
